643-2239-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
643-2239-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Maskwood Nexus, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Ardent Elementalist token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

1719-5921-5970-8201.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Vizier of Tumbling Sands.
Activate one of the Vizier of Tumbling Sands tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Vizier of Tumbling Sands token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

1339-6752-8192.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
1339-6752-8192.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters, Haliya triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Niv-Mizzet triggers, causing you to pay 1 life to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

3197-7687-7811.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
3197-7687-7811.description:
Draw a card.
Iron Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Mister Fantastic triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

1895-4399-4770-5789.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Pearl Medallion.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Lifecreed Duo triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Lifecreed Duo trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Lifecreed Duo trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
1895-4399-4770-5789.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

1090-1895-6867-7055.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Restoration Angel with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Restoration Angel from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Restoration Angel enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

284-2034-4013.description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Angel of Invention.
When Angel of Invention enters, it triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing two creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

3175-4050-5617.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Fungal Fortitude triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Fungal Fortitude from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Repeat.

4659-4907-6709-6989.easyPrerequisites: Ballad of the Black Flag's fourth chapter ability has triggered this turn

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

1563-2557-3499-3899.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

147-5117-6797.description:
Cast Undying Malice by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Undying Malice, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Undying Malice.
Holding priority, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Phantom Train abilities from step 5.

6556-6869-6884.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creatures with power 4 or greater.
6556-6869-6884.description:
Cast Aang, Airbending Master by paying {2}{W}
When Aang, Airbending Master enters, it triggers, airbending Aang, the Last Airbender
Cast Aang, the Last Airbender from exile by paying {0}.
When Aang, the Last Airbender enters, it triggers, airbending Aang, Airbending Master.
Cast Aang, Airbending Master from exile by paying {0}.
Repeat from step 2.
6556-6869-6884.notes: The mana cost can be reduced if you control more creatures with power 4 or greater to a minimum of {W}.

238-5756-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Gerrard.
When Gerrard dies, it and Havi trigger.
Resolve the Havi trigger, returning up to one legendary creature card with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Havi.
When Havi dies, it triggers, returning Gerrard from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Gerrard trigger from step 2, failing to exile it as it is no longer in your graveyard and returning Havi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot abilities from step 1 and 4.
Repeat.

252-969-4871.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature and have a way to cause that creature to die.
252-969-4871.description:
Kill any other creature you control.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token that enters the battlefield as a 7/7 Dinosaur due to Displaced Dinosaurs.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat from step 2.

703-4050-4394-4875.description:
Cast Everquill Phoenix for its mutate cost by paying {3}{R}, mutating it over or under a non-Human creature you control.
Everquill Phoenix triggers, creating a Feather artifact token.
Cast Astral Dragon by paying {6}{U}{U}.
When Astral Dragon enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating two copies of the Feather token that are 3/3 Dragon creatures.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Astral Dragon, adding {1}.
Activate a Feather by paying {1} and sacrificing it, returning Astral Dragon from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4.

2196-2821-5803-5928.notablePrerequisites:
Kitsa has power 2 or greater and does not have summoning sickness.
You control a land that can tap to produce at least {U}.
2196-2821-5803-5928.description:
Activate Balduvian Trading Post and another land by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Cast Frantic Search by paying {2}{U}.
Kitsa's prowess ability triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Holding priority, activate Kitsa's second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Frantic Search.
Resolve the copy of Frantic Search, causing you to loot twice and untap Minamo, Balduvian Trading Post and another land.
Activate Balduvian Trading Post and another land by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Activate Minamo's second ability by paying {U} and tapping it, untapping Kitsa.
Repeat from step 4.

2438-2781-6132.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Felidar Guardian.
2438-2781-6132.description:
Cast Felidar Guardian by paying its mana cost.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Felidar Guardian.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian ability, blinking Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Felidar Guardian from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

618-2034-4142.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Hostage Taker.
When the Hostage Taker token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Hostage Taker leaves the battlefield.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Hostage Taker token, adding {C}{C}.
When the Hostage Taker token dies, Kiki-Jiki is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat.

3617-4823-6122.notablePrerequisites: {1}{U} available plus enough mana to cast Time Walk and Timeless Witness each turn.
3617-4823-6122.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Timeless Witness by paying its mana cost.
When Timeless Witness enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Walk from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Dour Port-Mage by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, returning Timeless Witness from the battlefield to your hand.
Dour Port-Mage triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

509-2347-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Idris does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Idris.
509-2347-4222.description:
Activate Idris using Firemind Vessel's ability by tapping it, adding {1}{U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Idris.
Repeat.

509-2092-4131.notablePrerequisites:
Idris does not have summoning sickness.
Agatha of the Vile Cauldron has power 1 or greater.
509-2092-4131.description:
Activate Idris using Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Idris using Basalt Monolith's second ability by paying at most {2}, untapping it.
Repeat.

695-1760-4364.notablePrerequisites: An opponent is unable to block and kill Aurelia.
695-1760-4364.description:
Cast Surge to Victory by paying {4}{R}{R}, exiling Settle Beyond Reality from your graveyard and giving creatures you control +5/+0 until end of turn.
Declare Aurelia as an attacker.
Aurelia triggers, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Aurelia.
Surge to Victory triggers, casting a copy of Settle Beyond Reality without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Settle Beyond Reality, blinking Aurelia.
Repeat from step 2 each combat phase.
You may also choose both of Settle Beyond Reality's modes to exile any number of creatures opponents control.

1981-3333-5147.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1981-3333-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing another creature, dealing 1 damage to you, with your life total not changing due to Platinum Emperion.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more +1/+1 counters on it

2445-3693-4120.easyPrerequisites: Walking Ballista has a +1/+1 counter on it.
2445-3693-4120.description:
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter on it, targeting itself, but putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Vigor.
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter on it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.
2445-3693-4120.notes: You may also target your other creatures in step 2 to put +1/+1 counters on them due to Vigor.

1887-3609-4235.manaNeeded: {2} each odd-numbered turn, with {6} available each even-numbered turn
1887-3609-4235.notablePrerequisites: Magistrate's Scepter has at least three charge counters on it.
1887-3609-4235.description:
Activate Magistrate's Scepter's second ability by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers, causing you to pay {2} to copy Magistrate's Scepter's ability.
Resolve both Magistrate's Scepter's abilities, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Magistrate's Scepter's first ability by paying {4} and tapping it.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers, causing you to pay {2} to copy Magistrate's Scepter's ability.
Resolve both Magistrate's Scepter's abilities, putting four charge counters on it.
Move to your next turn.
Repeat.

3490-4659-4936.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a token to enter the battlefield under your control.
3490-4659-4936.description:
Cause a token to enter the battlefield under your control.
The token enters the battlefield, triggering Cloakwood Swarmkeeper, putting a +1/+1 counter on Cloakwood Swarmkeeper.
Animation Module triggers.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the token, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat from step 2.

1242-1656-5007.notablePrerequisites: Necrotic Ooze does not have summoning sickness.
1242-1656-5007.description:
Activate Necrotic Ooze by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Activate Necrotic Ooze by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Cavalier of Night

1430-4050-5011.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Mirror Image, adding one mana of any color.
When Mirror Image dies, its last ability from Cavalier of Night triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Cavalier of Night.
When Mirror Image enters the battlefield, its first triggered ability from Cavalier of Night triggers; choose not to sacrifice a creature.
Repeat.

1068-1295.description:
Cast Leveler by paying {5}.
Leveler enters the battlefield, triggering itself, exiling your library.
Cast Thassa's Oracle by paying {U}{U}.
Thassa's Oracle enters the battlefield, triggering itself, causing you to win the game.

186-411-1812-3168.description:
Activate Grinning Ignus by paying {R} and returning it to your hand, adding {C}{C}{R}.
Cast Grinning Ignus by paying {R}.
Activate Prismite by paying {1}, adding {R}.
Repeat.

1992-2292-4419.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with at least one +1/+1 counter.
1992-2292-4419.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing a creature with at least one +1/+1 counter.
Basri's Lieutenant trigger, creating a 2/2 Knight token.
When Knight token enters the battlefield, Renata trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Knight token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, scrying one.
Repeat.

224-2248-3756.description:
Activate Skyshroud Ranger by tapping it, putting Izzet Boilerworks from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Izzet Boilerworks enters the battlefield, it and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Resolve the Izzet Boilerworks trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Skyshroud Ranger.
Repeat.
